reviews.title: Good ITX 12th-14th gen Intel motherboard
reviews.comment: Good, basic, inexpensive motherboard for 12th-14th gen Intel socket 1700 CPUs. Works great with my i5-12400F and related RAM and parts.  PC3200 RAM is the maximum this chipset supports (a function of the chipset, not something Asus can control).  The motherboard cannot overclock RAM or CPU (again, a function of the chipset; not something Asus can control). The instructions are clear, everything booted up and worked on the first try, and the board has been absolutely reliable in near-daily use.  If you need a cheap ITX board for a non-overclocking CPU with DDR4, this is a great choice. The BIOS support (namely, the continued BIOS updates) is good, and is in line with other Asus motherboards; this is good.
reviews.author: dclive

reviews.title: Works on a Lian Li PC-CK101 Train Case with Linux and Existing 300-W SFX Power Supply!
reviews.comment: I purchased this mITX motherboard to install in my 2012-made Lian Li PC-CK101 Train PC case. Installation has been expectedly challenging in such a cramped case. The motherboard is installed in the steam locomotive's water tanker, with power cables leading to the locomotive itself. This board has been 100% functional. Everything, including the front panel USB slots, have worked! What I especially liked about this installation is that, the PC's existing 300-W SFX power supply is still usable! Of course, that depends on the CPU and any graphics. I'm running an i5 12600 with inbuilt graphics, along with the enclosed CPU fan. Not interested in gaming, using this just for my house related work, research, and software development. I didn't need to upgrade the power supply, though I know that I will need to eventually do this as modern processors become demanding. The operating system is RedHat Enterprise Linux 10.1 and it works straight out of the box! I may install Ubuntu if I don't like this, but I'm not using Windows and therefore no need for installing newer drivers. Maybe I'll install linux drivers from the Asus website (if available). All in all, a very satisfactory installation and a highly satisfied customer!
reviews.author: mammaearth

reviews.title: Solid budget ITX board for 12th gen Intel
reviews.comment: Built a compact system with this board and it’s handled everything I’ve thrown at it. BIOS is straightforward, POST times are quick, and the layout is sensible for the limited ITX space. VRM temps stay reasonable even with my 12700K. It’s not feature-packed like higher-end boards, but for the price point it delivers stable performance. The DDR4 support was perfect since I already had RAM on hand. Good choice if you’re doing a small form factor build without needing tons of PCIe slots or overclocking features
